description: Source code for Zephyr OS settings subsystem, including functions for initializing, registering handlers, parsing names, and committing settings.

methods.name: settings_init
methods.description: Initializes the settings subsystem, including dynamic handlers and storage.

methods.name: settings_register
methods.description: Registers a new settings handler if dynamic handlers are enabled.

methods.name: settings_name_steq
methods.description: Compares a name with a key, optionally returning the next position.

methods.name: settings_name_next
methods.description: Gets the next name segment after a given name.

methods.name: settings_parse_and_lookup
methods.description: Finds the best matching settings handler for a given name.

methods.name: settings_call_set_handler
methods.description: Calls the set handler for a given setting name.

methods.name: settings_commit_subtree
methods.description: Commits settings within a specified subtree.
